title: Use of LLMs for Illicit Purposes: Threats, Prevention Measures, and Vulnerabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing research that generates news stories with varied ideological viewpoints (left, right, center) to measure credibility and partisanship in LLM-generated misinformation.
Reviewing research evaluating AI text detectors, which found they erroneously classify non-native English compositions as AI-generated at higher rates.
Reviewing research that utilizes the Winogender benchmark to assess the ability of RLHF-trained models to morally self-correct via specific instructions.
Reviewing research using datasets around racial discrimination and universal adversarial triggers that cause models to generate racist output.
Reviewing research using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) to evaluate model safety and the reduction of social stereotypes through instruction tuning.
Reviewing research that employs red teaming to analyze distributional biases in model outputs with respect to protected groups.
Discussing concerns that LLM-assisted research writing may introduce biases when selecting related works.
